data.title: Ripple CEO Says Dutch Gold Move Shows Crypto’s Case
data.description: Ripple CEO Brad Garlinghouse said the Dutch central bank’s $11 billion gold transfer from New York to London shows how global finance still moves value through slow, legacy rails. According to BeInCrypto, De Nederlandsche Bank shifted roughly 86 tonnes between March and August, but nearly 70% was a paper exercise after selling about 59 tonnes in New York and repurchasing the same amount in London. Garlinghouse contrasted that with crypto’s rise from a $1.5 billion experiment to a $2.7 trillion asset class.

data.title: Bitcoin OG Holders Increase Activity as 90-Day Spent UTXO Average Reaches 1,500 BTC
data.description: Darkfost said activity among Bitcoin OG holders, defined as those who have held BTC for more than five years, has increased recently. According to Odaily, the 90-day moving average of their spent UTXOs has risen to 1,500 BTC, double the May level. The report said the transfers are not necessarily sales and may reflect moves to safer storage after events such as the Coldcard incident.

data.title: Trump Orders Review Of Endangered Status For Grey And Mexican Wolves
data.description:
According to the BBC, Donald Trump has signed an executive order to remove endangered species protections for the grey wolf and the Mexican wolf, giving Interior Secretary Doug Burgum 90 days to decide whether the populations have recovered enough to be taken off the list. The order could eventually allow ranchers to kill wolves that prey on livestock, though it does not give them immediate permission to do so.

US Fish and Wildlife Service figures showed 319 Mexican wolves in the wild in the US in 2025, up from four in 1998, while there are roughly 18,000 grey wolves across the country. Conservation groups criticized the move, saying it could undermine recovery efforts, and said ranchers already can receive compensation for livestock losses under the current system. The order comes as the Trump administration seeks to lower record-high beef prices for consumers amid drought and a parasite outbreak in US beef stocks.

data.title: U.S. And China Plan Mid-September AI Safety Talks Led By Scott Bessent
data.description:
According to CNBC, the United States and China are preparing to hold official bilateral talks on AI safety risks in mid-September, with U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent leading the U.S. side. The discussions would be the first bilateral meetings devoted exclusively to AI since President Donald Trump began his second term, and the agenda is expected to include cooperation on monitoring AI-directed cyberattacks, along with a U.S. proposal for American and Chinese AI labs to police themselves and share information to help prevent such attacks.

The talks come as Washington raises concerns about a future Chinese Mythos-level model with cyberattack capabilities and alleged Chinese distillation of proprietary U.S. AI models. On the Chinese side, the meeting could be led by Vice Premier He Lifeng, though Ding Xuexiang is also under consideration, while U.S. officials Michael Kratsios and Chinese science and technology minister Yin Hejun could attend. The final agenda, location and participants have not been set.

data.title: Leonardo CEO Mariani Sees Kyiv Unit as Deal Hub for Ukraine Defense Tech
data.description:

The Italian state-controlled defense company said the unit will serve as a base for those efforts.

data.title: Binance Wallet Expands LP Zap, Market Pages, and Web3 API Features
data.description: Binance announced on X that Binance Wallet has rolled out a weekly product update covering several areas across its wallet, web, and API tools. LP Zap now supports more EVM chains, while the LP position pop-up can display price ranges and remove liquidity. The market page has also been refreshed with an aggregated overview and dedicated Meme and stock sections. In addition, the tokenized stock detail page now includes access points for contract trading and the square feature. On the plugin side, a small-amount swap entry has been added, supporting conversions across up to 20 tokens. The update also includes new Web3 API functions for BSC-chain DeFi, B402 payments, and permission control. On the web interface, monitoring notification pop-ups now show market capitalization data to support trading decisions, search supports one-click purchases through Flash Buy, and token detail pages now allow custom indicator areas and a sidebar. The announcement did not provide further timing details for these features.
